en.title: Control Resonant Drops September 24, 2026, With Dylan Faden Front and Center
en.summary: Remedy Entertainment has officially revealed the release date for the highly anticipated sequel, Control Resonant. Players will step into the shoes of Dylan Faden when the game launches on September 24, 2026.
en.body:
After years of anticipation, Remedy Entertainment has finally pulled back the curtain on **Control Resonant**, confirming a September 24, 2026 release date. The reveal came alongside a brand-new trailer during a recent PlayStation State of Play, offering fans their first substantial look at the continuation of the Federal Bureau of Control's surreal and dangerous world. This time, players will embody **Dylan Faden**, the tormented brother of **Jesse Faden**, the protagonist from the original 2019 hit. The narrative will see Dylan confronting a catastrophic supernatural threat that has ensnared Manhattan and poses an existential danger to humanity itself.

This sequel marks a significant moment for Remedy, not only in its narrative ambition but also in its pricing strategy. The standard edition of **Control Resonant** will retail for $59.99, a refreshing departure from the $70 price tag becoming increasingly common for new AAA releases. For those seeking additional in-game content, a Digital Deluxe edition will be available for $69.99. PlayStation 5 owners are in for a particular treat, with a special PlayStation Digital Deluxe edition offering a 48-hour early access window, allowing them to dive into the supernatural chaos before anyone else.

## A New Faden Takes the Lead

The shift in protagonist to **Dylan Faden** is a compelling narrative choice that promises to explore new facets of the **Control** universe. The Hiss, the malevolent entity that plagued the Oldest House, appears to have expanded its reach, now consuming Manhattan and threatening global annihilation. The trailer hints at Dylan's own complex relationship with the supernatural forces at play, suggesting a journey of self-discovery and desperate struggle against overwhelming odds. Remedy's knack for intricate lore and mind-bending storytelling is expected to be on full display, offering both long-time fans and newcomers a rich, engaging experience.

> “Control Resonant is Remedy Entertainment’s most expansive game ever, complete with incredible gameplay, narrative twists and challenging creativity that will keep old fans and new engaged and entertained like nothing we have created before,” said **Johannes Paloheimo**, Remedy’s Chief Commercial Officer and head of publishing. He further elaborated on Remedy's ambitious marketing plans, stating, “As Remedy is self-publishing Control Resonant, our global marketing efforts will be just as ambitious in its execution and style, evidenced by this inclusion in the State of Play and leading us into Summer Game Fest and beyond.”

## Community Buzz and Pricing Relief

The announcement has naturally sent waves of excitement through the **Control** fanbase. The confirmation of a sequel, especially one featuring **Dylan Faden**, has been a long-awaited moment. The potential for new powers, expanded lore, and deeper dives into the Bureau's mysteries has the community buzzing. Perhaps one of the most welcome pieces of news is the $60 price point for the standard edition. In an era where $70 is becoming the norm, this decision by Remedy, who is self-publishing, offers a significant value proposition to players and has been met with widespread approval. This move underscores Remedy's commitment to its player base and its confidence in the game's inherent value.

## What's Next

With the September 24, 2026 release date set for macOS, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S, fans can expect Remedy to ramp up its marketing efforts in the coming months, with potential further reveals expected at events like Summer Game Fest. Keep an eye out for more details on gameplay mechanics and the full extent of Dylan's journey.

tr.title: Control Resonant: Dylan Faden'in Yükselişi 24 Eylül 2026'da
tr.summary: Remedy Entertainment, uzun zamandır beklenen sequel'in resmi çıkış tarihini açıkladı. Oyuncular, 24 Eylül 2026'da **Dylan Faden** olarak oyunu oynayacak.
tr.body:
Yıllarca süren beklentiden sonra, Remedy Entertainment nihayet **Control Resonant**'ın çıkış tarihini açıkladı. Bu, Federal Bureau of Control'un kafa karıştırıcı ve tehlikeli dünyasının devamı niteliğinde. Bu kez, oyuncular **Jesse Faden**'in kardeşini, **Dylan Faden**'i oynayacak. Hikaye, Manhattan'ı ele geçiren ve insanlığın varoluşunu tehdit eden kabus gibi bir tehditle karşı Dylan'ın mücadelesini gösterecektir.

Bu sequel, Remedy için önemli bir anı temsil ediyor. Hem hikayenin hem de fiyatlandırma stratejisinin bir dönüm noktası. **Control Resonant**'ın standard sürümü $59,99'a satılacak, yeni AAA oyunlarının giderek yaygınlaşan $70 fiyat etiketinden farklılık gösterecek. Ek içerik için daha fazla seçenek sunan bir Digital Deluxe sürümü de $69,99'a satılacak. PlayStation 5 sahipleri, özel bir PlayStation Digital Deluxe sürümüne sahip olacaklar ve 48 saat erken erişime sahip olacaklar.

## Bir Yeni Faden Önderliği

Dylan Faden'in ana karakter olarak seçilmesi, **Control** evreninin yeni yönlerini keşfetmeyi vaat eden bir hikaye seçimi. The Hiss, Oldest House'u ele geçiren ve Manhattan'ı ele geçiren bir tehdit gibi, şimdi küresel bir yok oluş tehdidi haline geldi. Trailer, Dylan'ın kendi karmaşık ilişkisinin ve kabus gibi güçlerle mücadelesinin bir yolculuğunu gösteriyor. Remedy Entertainment'in karmaşık hikaye ve zihin bükücü hikaye anlatma yetenekleri, hem eski hem de yeni oyuncular için zengin ve çekici bir deneyim sunacak.

> “Control Resonant, Remedy Entertainment'in en geniş oyunudur. İnanılmaz oyun oynaması, hikaye çevirileri ve zorlu yaratıcılık, eski ve yeni oyuncuları, hiç yaratmadığımız kadar tutkulu ve eğlenceli bir deneyimle tutacak.” dedi **Johannes Paloheimo**, Remedy'nin Pazarlama Yöneticisi ve Yayıncı Başkanı.

## Topluluk Fırtınası ve Fiyat Artışından Kurtulma

Açıklama, **Control** topluluğunda heyecan dalgaları gönderdi. Dylan Faden'in ana karakter olarak seçilmesi, uzun zamandır beklenen bir an. Yeni güçler, genişlemiş hikaye ve Büro'nun gizemlerinin daha derinlemesine keşfi, toplulukta fırtınalar koparmaya başladı. Fiyatlandırma kararı, özellikle $60'ın standard sürüm fiyatı, oyunculara önemli bir değer önerisi sunuyor. Bu karar, Remedy'nin oyuncularına bağlılığını ve oyunun kendi değerini gözler önüne seriyor.

## Gelecek

24 Eylül 2026'da macOS, PlayStation 5, Windows ve Xbox Series X/S için çıkış tarihi belirlenen oyuncular, Remedy'nin pazarlama çabalarını yakında artırmaya başlayacak. Potansiyel olarak daha fazla açıklama, Summer Game Fest gibi etkinliklerde beklenmektedir. Daha fazla oyun mekanizması ve Dylan'ın yolculuğu hakkında bilgi için bekleyin.

es.title: Resonancia Control: Dylan Faden al centro del escenario el 24 de septiembre de 2026
es.summary: La exitosa franquicia de Remedy Entertainment confirma su regreso con una fecha de lanzamiento oficial para el 24 de septiembre de 2026. Los jugadores asumirán el papel de Dylan Faden en esta nueva entrega.
es.body:
Después de años de espera, Remedy Entertainment ha revelado finalmente la fecha de lanzamiento oficial para **Resonancia Control**, confirmándola para el 24 de septiembre de 2026. La revelación se produjo junto con un nuevo tráiler durante el reciente PlayStation State of Play, ofreciendo a los fans su primera mirada sustancial a la continuación del mundo surreal y peligroso del Federal Bureau of Control. En esta ocasión, los jugadores asumirán el papel de **Dylan Faden**, el hermano perturbado de **Jesse Faden**, el protagonista del exitoso lanzamiento de 2019. La narrativa verá a Dylan enfrentando una amenaza sobrenatural catastrófica que ha envuelto a Manhattan y plantea un peligro existencial para la humanidad en sí misma.

Esta secuela marca un momento importante para Remedy, no solo en su ambición narrativa sino también en su estrategia de precios. La edición estándar de **Resonancia Control** saldrá a la venta por $59.99, una clara desviación del precio de $70 que se está volviendo cada vez más común para los nuevos lanzamientos AAA. Para aquellos que buscan contenido adicional en juego, estará disponible una edición Digital Deluxe por $69.99. Los propietarios de PlayStation 5 tienen un trato especial en espera, con una edición Digital Deluxe de PlayStation que ofrece una ventana de acceso temprano de 48 horas, permitiéndoles sumergirse en la caótica locura sobrenatural antes que nadie.

## Un Nuevo Faden al Frente

La transición del protagonista a **Dylan Faden** es una elección narrativa atractiva que promete explorar nuevos aspectos del universo de **Control**. El Hiss, la entidad malevolente que plagó la Casa más antigua, parece haber ampliado su alcance, ahora consumiendo Manhattan y amenazando con la aniquilación global. El tráiler da a entender que la relación compleja de Dylan con las fuerzas sobrenaturales en juego sugiere un viaje de auto-descubrimiento y una lucha desesperada contra imposibles. La habilidad de Remedy para crear una intrincada trama y una narrativa que desafía la mente se espera que esté en pleno funcionamiento, ofreciendo tanto a los fans de larga data como a los nuevos un experiencia rica y atractiva.

> "Resonancia Control es el juego más ambicioso de Remedy Entertainment hasta la fecha, completo con increíbles mecánicas de juego, giros narrativos y creatividad desafiante que mantendrá a los fans antiguos y nuevos enganchados y entretenidos como nunca antes", dijo **Johannes Paloheimo**, Director Comercial Jefe y jefe de publicación de Remedy.

## Bulla Comunitaria y Alivio de Precios

La anuncio ha enviado olas de emoción a través del fanbase de **Control**. La confirmación de una secuela, especialmente una que presenta a **Dylan Faden**, ha sido un momento esperado a largo plazo. El potencial de nuevos poderes, una expansión de la trama y una exploración más profunda de los misterios del Bureau tiene a la comunidad bullanguera. Quizás una de las noticias más bienvenidas es el precio de $60 para la edición estándar. En una era en la que $70 se está convirtiendo en la norma, esta decisión de Remedy, que se auto-publica, ofrece una propuesta de valor significativa a los jugadores y ha sido recibida con aprobación general. Esta decisión subraya el compromiso de Remedy con su base de jugadores y su confianza en el valor inherente del juego.

## Próximos Pasos

Con la fecha de lanzamiento del 24 de septiembre de 2026 establecida para macOS, PlayStation 5, Windows y Xbox Series X/S, los fans pueden esperar que Remedy acelere sus esfuerzos de marketing en los próximos meses, con posibles revelaciones adicionales esperadas en eventos como Summer Game Fest. Mantengan los ojos abiertos para más detalles sobre las mecánicas de juego y la extensión completa del viaje de Dylan.

content_raw: The release date for Control Resonant was finally revealed alongside a new trailer revealed at the PlayStation State of Play. It's coming September 24 this year and the new trailer gave us another look at the story of Control Resonant, the sequel to Remedy Entertainment's 2019 beloved action game. This time, players will fill the shoes of Dylan Faden, the tortured brother of Jesse Faden (protagonist of the first game), to stop a castastrophic supernatural threat that has consumed Manhattan and could eliminate humanity as we know it. Remedy isn't following the new norm for AAA game pricing, as the standard edition will cost just $59.99, which is $10 cheaper than what's expected nowadays. However, if you want some extra in-game goodies you can pay $69.99 for the digital deluxe edition. PlayStation players will also get a big bonus, as there will be a special PlayStation digital deluxe edition that grants players 48-hours of early access. This will only be available to PS5 owners, so Xbox and PC players will have to wait until September 24 to jump in on the action. “ Control Resonant is Remedy Entertainment’s most expansive game ever, complete with incredible gameplay, narrative twists and challenging creativity that will keep old fans and new engaged and entertained like nothing we have created before,” said Johannes Paloheimo, Remedy’s Chief Commercial Officer and head of publishing. “As Remedy is self-publishing Control Resonant, our global marketing efforts will be just as ambitious in its execution and style, evidenced by this inclusion in the State of Play and leading us into Summer Game Fest and beyond. We will have a number of events and opportunities for fans over the summer as we move towards the game’s release on September 24.” Additionally, game director Mikael Kasurinen gave a deeper look on the story of Control Resonant on the official PlayStation blog. We had a hands-off Control Resonant preview opportunity back in March, and executive previews editor Ryan McCaffrey came away impressed, concluding, "After seeing Control Resonant’s aggressive, fast-paced combat for myself, I’m even more fired up to get my hands on it." Control Resonant may also be a continuation of some of the events from Alan Wake 2 , as the games share a universe, but it's unclear how important Alan Wake's previous story will be to this game. Remedy is also currently developing remakes of the first two Max Payne games in partnership with Rockstar Games. More details will be shared on those games at a later date. The State of Play stream was packed with reveals, including God of War Laufey, which we have an exclusive developer interview for; and for all the other announcements, check out our roundup of everything from the June 2026 State of Play . Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.
